title: Rewards Partner LATAM
description:
Empresa está contratando Rewards Partner LATAM em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the role  Leads the execution of the Total Rewards agenda across Latin America, translating strategy into impactful and scalable compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs that support Kerry's business and people priorities. This role partners closely with HR and business leaders to deliver market-competitive reward solutions, ensuring a seamless balance between employee experience, operational excellence, compliance, and cost effectiveness. Through strong stakeholder management, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement, the role drives consistent delivery, fosters cross-functional collaboration, and ensures Rewards programs create meaningful value for employees and the business. Key responsibilities  Strategic Rewards Partner  Act as the trusted Rewards advisor to HR and business leaders across LATAM, translating global Rewards strategies into practical regional solutions that support business growth, talent priorities, and organizational effectiveness. Partner with HR Leadership Teams and business stakeholders to develop and execute Rewards programs that attract, retain, motivate, and engage talent while ensuring market competitiveness and internal equity. Provide strategic guidance on compensation, benefits, recognition, incentive, and workforce planning matters, balancing business needs, employee experience, governance, and cost effectiveness. Leverage market intelligence, analytics, and external benchmarking to identify trends, assess risks, and inform reward-related decisions. Support organizational transformation initiatives, including restructures, acquisitions, integrations, and talent-related projects, ensuring Rewards considerations are effectively incorporated into business decisions.  Rewards Centre of Excellence Partner  Partner with Global Rewards and regional HR teams to implement and sustain Rewards programs, policies, frameworks, and governance across LATAM. Drive the regional delivery of annual Rewards processes including salary reviews, incentive plans, market pricing, job architecture, pay transparency, and benefits governance. Ensure Rewards programs remain compliant with local legislation, company policies, and regulatory requirements across the countries within scope. Lead the assessment, design, and continuous improvement of Rewards programs to enhance employee value proposition, operational effectiveness, and cost management. Develop and execute communication and change management strategies that improve understanding and adoption of Rewards programs among leaders, HR teams, and employees. Provide subject matter expertise and coaching to HRBPs and people leaders on Rewards philosophy, policies, tools, and decision-making frameworks.  Business & Operational Execution  Build strong partnerships with HRBPs, Finance, Legal, Payroll, Global Rewards, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation of Rewards initiatives. Support data-driven decision making through analysis, insights, and recommendations related to compensation, benefits, workforce costs, and talent outcomes. Monitor Rewards program effectiveness through KPIs, market benchmarking, employee feedback, and governance reviews, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Drive high-quality execution of Rewards projects and processes, ensuring consistency, service excellence, and alignment with regional and global priorities. Contribute to the development of regional guidelines, policies, and governance frameworks that enable scalable and sustainable Rewards practices across LATAM.  Qualifications and skills  • A Bachelor’s degree (Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business or other applicable field) • Minimum of ten (10) years broad based human resources experience, with significant experience at influencing; Experience in the food/flavours manufacturing industry desirable • English, Portuguese and Spanish language capability (fluent in writing, speaking) About Kerry  Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

Um futuro onde estamos sempre olhando para frente. Sempre oferecendo novas maneiras de vivenciar os momentos da vida. Um futuro onde continuamos a sonhar cada vez mais alto. Buscamos pessoas com paixão, talento e curiosidade, e oferecemos a elas colegas de equipe, recursos e oportunidades para que liberem todo o seu potencial. O poder que criamos juntos – quando unimos suas forças às nossas – é imparável. Você está pronto para se juntar a uma equipe que sonha tão grande quanto você? title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.  Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention  Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.  Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.  Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.  Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.  Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.  Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.  Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.  Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.  Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.  Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.  Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.  Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.  Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.  Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.  Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.  Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.  Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.  Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.  Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.  Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.  Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).  Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.   Collaboration  Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.  Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.  Monitor students’ progress and well-being.  Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.  Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.  Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.  Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.  Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.  Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.  Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.   Operational and Professional Conduct  Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.  Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.  Maintain accurate student records.  Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.  Participate in professional development opportunities.  Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.  Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.  Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide.   Other duties, as assigned.  Working Conditions:  Walk on paths and rough terrain  May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up   POSITION REQUIREMENTS  Minimum Education Required:    BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent  Minimum Experience Required:  Five years of teaching experience, preferred  Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.  Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.   Specific Knowledge:  Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.  Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.  Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.   Other Skills (Desirable):  Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.  Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.  Collegial and collaborative.  Innovative and creative.  Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.   English level required:  C1 or above  Portuguese level required:  none for teachers instructing in English  C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.  We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.  At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Change Management Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Change Management Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the role  You are accountable for the model itself — that it works, that it is documented, and that it earns the right to scale. Help select the rest of the squad. A team assembled before its manager arrives inherits someone else’s judgement about fit, and this manager will be held accountable for the D+90 recommendation either way. What you'll do  Own the playbook: define the methodology, document it, and enforce quality on it across both pilots. Protect the squad from being used as generic capacity. Refuse work that does not move partner adoption, and make that refusal visible rather than quiet. Manage senior individual contributors who work outside the building — a genuinely different problem from managing a co-located team. Hold nine pillar owners to commitments they did not originally make. Help select every other seat on the squad. Fit is your call, not a hand-me-down. Know at day 60 whether the pilot is going to fail — leading indicators, not lagging ones — and be willing to recommend stopping. Treat your calendar as a lever: more time from this leader on the programme moves success probability more than a budget increase of similar size.  What you'll need  Strong experience in transformation leadership, consulting practice management, or a senior commercial role carrying a change portfolio. Experience managing senior individual contributors who work outside the building. Executive influence across functional boundaries; able to hold senior owners to commitments they did not originally make. Methodology ownership: able to define a playbook and enforce quality on it. Strong English and Spanish (both written and spoken).  Desirable  Has built a team from zero before. Change-management certification (Prosci, CCMP, APMG or HCMBOOK) — for credibility with the practitioners they will manage, not as a gate.  More about you  You manage remotely without surveilling. You kill work that does not move adoption. Strong sounds like: leading indicators at day 60, and a willingness to recommend stopping.  What We Offer  Performance based bonus* Attendance Bonus* Private pension plan Meal Allowance Casual office and dress code Days off* Health, dental, and life insurance Medicines discounts WellHub partnership Childcare subsidies Discounts on Ambev products* Clube Ben partnership Scholarship* School materials assurance Language and training platforms Transport allowance  *Rules applied

Estamos presentes em 26 estados, com 226 lojas próprias espalhadas pelo Brasil. Somos convictos, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas pela força da nossa essência. Somos fazedores, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas com ações práticas. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas a fazerem mais e melhor. Somos criadores, acreditamos que sendo curiosos e tendo sede pelo novo, vamos criar o que ainda não foi feito. Movimentar é o nosso esporte

title: Change Management Lead
description:
Empresa está contratando Change Management Lead em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the role  You are accountable for the partner’s transformation succeeding: the right problems chosen, the sponsor active, the change adopted. You operate at C-level and at depot level in the same week. Where a technical decision does not serve adoption, you decide. What you'll do  Own the partner’s change outcome — not a comms plan, not a training calendar, measured adoption after go-live. Diagnose resistance (money, status, workload) before prescribing training or process. Coach partner executives who do not report to you; keep the sponsor active through the full cycle. Decide which problems the squad works on, in conversation with the Technical Implementation & Delivery Manager and the Senior Developer. Build and run the change approach using a structured methodology (Prosci ADKAR, Kotter, HCMBOOK or equivalent) through to behaviour change. Mobilise BEES pillars and Solutions Engineering through the TIDM; escalate when a technical shortcut would kill adoption. Travel with the squad into warehouses, call centres and depots — this role is not done from a meeting room.  What you'll need  Strong experience in consulting or corporate transformation, and minimum 3 years leading organisational change end-to-end, and minimum 2 years on technology-enabled or digital transformation, and exposure to consumer goods, retail or distribution. Experience leading change using a structured methodology through to measured adoption, not only to go-live. Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and to coach senior executives who do not report to you. Track record of working inside another company’s operation, at leadership level and on the floor in the same week. Able to operate amid ambiguity, shifting priorities and incomplete information. Strong English and Spanish (both written and spoken).  Bachelor’s degree.  Desirable  Prosci Certified Practitioner, CCMP, APMG Change Management Practitioner, or HCMBOOK. Certification is preferred, not a gate. Experience with route-to-market or distributor transformation. A second language relevant to the pilot markets.  More about you  Your examples name a behaviour that changed or a result that moved — not only deliverables. You do not reach for formal authority in influence stories. You can describe what a failure taught you. You are credible and composed in front of a partner’s owner.  What We Offer  Performance based bonus* Attendance Bonus* Private pension plan Meal Allowance Casual office and dress code Days off* Health, dental, and life insurance Medicines discounts WellHub partnership Childcare subsidies Discounts on Ambev products* Clube Ben partnership Scholarship* School materials assurance Language and training platforms Transport allowance  *Rules applied

Formação:  Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Telecomunicações, Elétrica, Produção), Administração, Gestão de Processos ou áreas afins;  Pós-graduação ou certificações em Gestão de Projetos (PMP, PMBOK, Scrum Master) serão consideradas diferenciais. description:

OBJETIVO DA POSIÇÃO  Garantir a governança fiscal e tributária da organização, com foco principal em tributos indiretos, especialmente ICMS nos diversos estados do Brasil, PIS e COFINS, assegurando que as atividades executadas pelo SSC e demais áreas envolvidas estejam em conformidade com a legislação vigente, políticas internas e diretrizes da ORÍGEO. O Coordenador Tributário atua como referência técnica e ponto focal entre Controladoria, SSC, áreas de negócio, consultorias, auditorias e órgãos fiscalizadores, acompanhando a qualidade das entregas, validando criticamente apurações, obrigações acessórias, créditos fiscais, controles e tratativas fiscais relevantes. Este papel é estratégico para a mitigação de riscos fiscais, otimização tributária dentro dos limites legais, suporte à tomada de decisão e condução dos impactos decorrentes da Reforma Tributária, com foco em processos, sistemas, créditos fiscais, fluxo financeiro, contabilização, controles internos e aderência operacional ao novo modelo tributário. ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES  Governança da Conformidade Fiscal e Acompanhamento do SSC:  acompanhar e validar criticamente as apurações, recolhimentos, créditos, obrigações acessórias e demais rotinas fiscais executadas pelo SSC, com foco principal em tributos indiretos, especialmente ICMS nos diversos estados do Brasil, PIS e COFINS, assegurando aderência à legislação federal, estadual e municipal, às políticas internas, prazos, controles e padrões de qualidade definidos pela ORÍGEO. Act as the local commercial point of contact, with recurring in-person presence at clients and prospects across São Paulo. Build and manage your own pipeline, from qualification through close, in coordination with the Head of Sales LATAM and the Inside Sales/SDR team. Track and monitor local competitors (MVNOs and IoT connectivity providers operating in the region). Present technical-commercial proposals, including products such as SIM DUO, vSIM, and eSIM, together with the Solutions team. Negotiate contracts, commercial terms, and SLAs with corporate clients. Report pipeline metrics, forecast, and results in a structured way.  What We Expect  Farm and Grow the Existing Base  Take ownership of and grow the accounts already established in São Paulo, increasing volume and revenue within the current portfolio. Keep clients satisfied through constant visits and recurring in-person presence — not just remote contact. Ensure fast response to client requests and demands, acting as their trusted local point of contact. Anticipate churn risk and act proactively to retain and expand strategic accounts.  Grow — Bring In New Accounts  Prospect and close new accounts quickly, with a strong sense of urgency and focus on results. Directly contribute to revenue growth in the region, not just maintenance of the current portfolio. Establish Acceleronix's active presence in São Paulo — participation in events, trade shows, and visits that reinforce the brand locally. Build a consistent pipeline of new business, without relying solely on leads handed over by the SDR team.  Requirements  Required  Based in Campinas, São Paulo, or willing to relocate to the region. Proven track record in consultative B2B sales, preferably in telecom, connectivity, IoT/M2M, or technology. Hybrid farmer/hunter profile — able to grow existing accounts while also generating and converting new pipeline. Availability for frequent travel within the region. Strong written and verbal communication, autonomy, and organization to manage a complex sales cycle.  Nice to Have  Prior experience at an MVNO, carrier, or IoT/M2M connectivity provider. Familiarity with industry concepts: SIM DUO, vSIM, eSIM, national roaming, ICCID/IMSI/IMEI, LTE-M, NB-IoT. Existing relationships with clients or partners in fleet management and vehicle tracking in São Paulo. Intermediate/advanced English, for interaction with the Quectel group.  About Acceleronix  Acceleronix is Quectel's integrated IoT platform and connectivity company, built to help businesses launch and scale connected products faster. The company provides consulting, PCBA design, global SIM connectivity, and a secure device management platform, bringing hardware, connectivity, and software together into a single, end-to-end offering rather than requiring customers to stitch together separate vendors. Operating as part of the Quectel ecosystem, Acceleronix is positioned as a trusted end-to-end IoT partner delivering scalable, reliable solutions from design through deployment, and appears alongside Quectel at major industry events such as MWC and the World IT Show to showcase joint IoT deployments across smart agriculture, smart home, and connected-device use cases. Gerente de Finanças | Operações Globais & PMO  PROPÓSITO DA FUNÇÃO  Atuar como parceiro estratégico de negócios para a área de Global Operations & PMO, liderando a gestão financeira, iniciativas de criação de valor e transformação de processos em escala global. O profissional será responsável por impulsionar melhorias contínuas, gerar insights por meio de análises financeiras e de dados, apoiar a tomada de decisões executivas e garantir o acompanhamento financeiro das iniciativas estratégicas da organização. Liderar análises financeiras e de dados que apoiem decisões estratégicas. Desenvolver e implementar planos de melhoria e iniciativas de otimização de desempenho. Atuar em projetos de transformação organizacional, gestão de mudanças e melhoria de processos. Promover a padronização, eficiência operacional e excelência na execução.  Gestão Financeira e Ciclo de Planejamento Coordenar os processos de planejamento financeiro de curto e longo prazo (1YP e 10YP), alinhados ao ciclo de negócios da AB InBev. Monitorar e analisar resultados financeiros reais versus planejados, identificando desvios e oportunidades de correção. Preparar projeções financeiras (Latest Estimate - LE) considerando entregas realizadas e futuras. Realizar análises detalhadas por zona, localização, função e iniciativa estratégica. Garantir o acompanhamento proativo dos business cases e captura dos benefícios previstos.  Business Partnering e Governança Ser o principal responsável pelos resultados financeiros da área Global S&O. Garantir a disponibilidade de informações financeiras precisas, transparentes e tempestivas. Trabalhar em estreita parceria com líderes globais para apoiar decisões estratégicas. Desenvolver dashboards, apresentações executivas e materiais de visualização de dados para liderança sênior e stakeholders. Assegurar alto nível de governança financeira e qualidade das informações reportadas.  Outras Atividades Apoiar projetos e iniciativas adicionais definidos pela liderança da equipe de Value Creation de Global S&O. Participar de iniciativas estratégicas voltadas para inovação, produtividade e crescimento sustentável do negócio.  QUALIFICAÇÕES, EXPERIÊNCIA E HABILIDADES  Requisitos Obrigatórios Formação superior Experiência em Finanças, Controladoria, Planejamento Financeiro ou Gestão de Projetos. Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta complexidade. Sólida capacidade analítica e visão estratégica de negócios. Excelente habilidade de comunicação e influência. Forte capacidade de gestão de stakeholders. Alto nível de organização e atenção aos detalhes. Precisão e excelência na gestão e análise de dados.   COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS  Essenciais Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A) Gestão de OPEX Construção e acompanhamento de Business Cases Análise Financeira e Modelagem de Dados Gestão de Projetos Gestão de Mudanças (Change Management) Data Analytics e Visualização de Dados Desenvolvimento de apresentações executivas Gestão de Performance e Indicadores  Desejáveis Conhecimento em metodologias de melhoria contínua. Experiência com transformação digital e automação de processos. Conhecimento avançado em Power BI, Power Query e ferramentas analíticas. Certificações em Gestão de Projetos (PMP, Agile, Scrum ou similares).  Por que esta oportunidade?  Esta é uma posição estratégica com ampla exposição à liderança global da AB InBev, oferecendo a oportunidade de influenciar decisões de grande impacto, liderar iniciativas de transformação e contribuir diretamente para a criação de valor e crescimento sustentável da organização em escala mundial. 🚀

title: Especialista de Planograma
description:

PLANOGRAMA   Objetivo da Posição  O Especialista em Planogramas é responsável por criar, entregar e aprimorar continuamente planogramas de alta qualidade dentro do CatExpert.ai , a plataforma de Gestão por Categorias impulsionada por IA da AB InBev, atualmente utilizada em mais de 15 mercados ao redor do mundo. Trata-se de uma posição operacional e prática, com forte orientação para o negócio. O profissional atuará em estreita colaboração com equipes de mercado em diferentes zonas geográficas para garantir que os planogramas sejam visualmente precisos, estrategicamente alinhados e aderentes aos parâmetros de negócio definidos. A posição está no centro da capacidade de execução de gôndola do CatExpert.ai, transformando lógicas de clusterização de lojas, definições de espaço e diretrizes de fluxo em planogramas capazes de gerar melhorias mensuráveis nos KPIs de varejo. A pessoa nessa função será a principal referência operacional para entrega de planogramas em seus mercados, impulsionando qualidade, velocidade e consistência em escala, fator essencial para suportar o crescimento do CatExpert.ai rumo à geração simultânea de milhares de planogramas em mercados globais. 2. Principais Responsabilidades  Desenvolvimento e Entrega de Planogramas Criar e entregar versões de planogramas com base na clusterização de lojas, definições de espaço e diretrizes de fluxo aprovadas por cada mercado. Garantir que os planogramas sejam visualmente atrativos, comercialmente corretos e aderentes aos parâmetros de negócio e padrões de exposição definidos. Apoiar o objetivo de geração de planogramas em escala dentro do CatExpert.ai, permitindo processamento paralelo de grande volume para múltiplos mercados simultaneamente. Manter controle de versões e documentação de todos os planogramas produzidos, assegurando rastreabilidade e auditoria das solicitações dos mercados.  Colaboração com Mercados e Gestão de Stakeholders  Atuar como principal parceiro operacional dos mercados em diferentes regiões, promovendo alinhamento e consistência na execução dos planogramas. Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de Gestão por Categorias dos mercados para validar parâmetros dos planogramas e garantir impacto positivo nos resultados de negócio. Coletar e incorporar rapidamente feedbacks dos mercados, ajustando os planogramas conforme mudanças nas estratégias de exposição.  Excelência Operacional e Controle de Qualidade  Conduzir melhorias contínuas nos processos para aumentar eficiência, qualidade e velocidade de entrega dos planogramas. Identificar gargalos na construção dos planogramas e propor soluções, especialmente aquelas que possam ser resolvidas por meio das funcionalidades do CatExpert.ai. Comparar a qualidade dos planogramas gerados com ferramentas concorrentes, como JDA, SpacePlano e ShelfIQ, sinalizando oportunidades de melhoria ao time de produto.  Gestão de Projetos  Gerenciar simultaneamente múltiplos projetos de planogramas, demonstrando forte capacidade de priorização e cumprimento de prazos. Manter visibilidade clara sobre pipeline, cronogramas e status das entregas, comunicando proativamente avanços e impedimentos aos stakeholders.  3. Qualificações, Experiência e Competências  Formação Acadêmica Ensino superior completo. Formação em Administração, Gestão do Varejo ou áreas correlatas será considerada diferencial.  Experiência Obrigatória  Entre 5 e 8 anos de experiência em planejamento de espaço e execução de planogramas utilizando ferramentas como JDA, Spaceman, Hoffrogge  ou similares. Experiência prática com planejamento de layout de lojas e otimização de espaços de vendas. Histórico comprovado de entrega de planogramas para múltiplos mercados ou contas varejistas simultaneamente. Experiência de trabalho com equipes de Gestão por Categorias ou Trade Marketing em empresas de bens de consumo (CPG/FMCG).  Desejável  Experiência com ferramentas de planogramas baseadas em inteligência artificial ou plataformas de automação. Conhecimento de metodologias de clusterização de lojas e sua aplicação na definição de espaço de gôndola. Experiência em ambientes globais ou multinacionais, atuando com stakeholders de diferentes culturas.  Idiomas  Inglês:  nível intermediário. Português ou Espanhol:  nível avançado/proficiente.  4. Competências Técnicas  Obrigatórias Proficiência em softwares de planejamento de espaço como JDA, Spaceman, Hoffrogge  ou equivalentes. Excel avançado, incluindo manipulação de dados, tabelas dinâmicas e relatórios. Sólido conhecimento de parâmetros de conformidade de planogramas, métricas de gôndola (facings, capacidade, fluxo) e KPIs de varejo. Capacidade de interpretar layouts físicos de loja e resultados de clusterização.  Desejáveis  Experiência com o CatExpert.ai  ou plataformas semelhantes de gestão por categorias baseadas em IA. Conhecimentos básicos de SQL ou consultas de dados para extração de informações de vendas e espaço. Familiaridade com ferramentas de validação de planogramas por imagem.  INFORMAÇÕES BENEFICIOS:  40 dias de home office; Vale refeição ou alimentação ifood; Vale transporte; Bônus; Plano de saúde e Telemedicina; Convênio odontológico; Convênio Farmácia; Seguro de vida; Instituto Ambev de Previdência Privada; Auxílio Material Escolar; Cesta de Natal e Kit Congelado; Brinquedos de Natal; Empresa cidadã (licença maternidade e paternidade) e presente do bebê; Desconto mensal em produtos AMBEV; Wellhub (Gympass); Fretado; Abono anual referente a um salário.

title: CONSULTOR COMERCIAL - CAMPINAS
description:

A Iguatemi S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.  ⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO  Responsável pela comercialização dos espaços das lojas (SUCs: salão de uso comercial) nos shoppings de sua responsabilidade, maximizando a geração de receitas, superando as metas de redução de vacância estipuladas, substituindo operações não sadias e que não sejam aderentes ao mix do empreendimento, com objetivo de atingir ou superar a meta estipulada para cada SUC. Responsável em prospectar novos clientes com perfil desejado para atuar nos empreendimentos a serem comercializados, seguindo o direcionamento da área de Mix.   RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como?  Comercialização das áreas vagas: prospecção de novos lojistas, análise SWOT dos espaços ofertados(pontos fortes x desafios), negociações de valores e condições contratuais com lojistas, acompanhamento após a assinatura do contrato; Estabelecer contato inicial com lojista: prospecção do contato comercial referente à marca indicada pelo Mix, apresentação da oportunidade para o lojista e captura de interesse preliminar do mesmo, agendamento e realização de reuniões; Negociação: Elaboração da proposta comercial (Salesforce) com base nas metas definidas pelo Iguatemi, apresentação da proposta para o lojista e negociação da mesma, ajustes na proposta comercial se necessário, atualização do status de cada negociação no sistema, envio de informações técnicas sobre o SUC e levantamento junto ao lojista de eventuais necessidades de alterações para serem aprovadas e discutidas com demais áreas; Acompanhar o andamento da proposta comercial no fluxo de aprovações e, após alçadas de aprovações internas, efetuar o retorno para o lojista; Fechamento: Coleta de documentação e assinatura de contrato do lojista, entrega dos documentos para equipe de operações comerciais responsável pelos inputs de dados cadastrais; Acompanhamento: Uma vez assinado o contrato, apresentar o lojista à equipe de operações e manutenção, efetuar o acompanhamento da obra periodicamente de modo a garantir abertura da loja. Uma vez que a loja esteja aberta, realizar as boas vindas ao lojista e passagem de bastão para área de operações; Alimentar a base de contatos de lojistas do Iguatemi (Salesforce), fazendo inputs de dados cadastrais do mesmo (completando o que é previamente enviado por mix); Participar das reuniões: RECOP, Matinais com GG, Reuniões semanais e mensais de atualização de status com Gerente Regional, Encontro Anual das Áreas e Programas de Excelência, entre outros.    OBSERVACÕES  Ensino Superior completo (mandatório); CRECI - Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis (mandatório); Experiência prévia na área comercial como executivo/consultor comercial, preferencialmente em empresas de bens de consumo, shopping center, varejo ou imobiliária; Conhecer bem os empreendimentos e oportunidades a serem vendidas (Concorrência, entorno, SWOT, etc).

title: 经理
description:
Nova vaga disponível para 经理 em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

1. Take full responsibility for the plant quality team and Quality Management System. Develop annual quality objectives, operating plans, departmental budgets, and quality improvement programs, and remain accountable for overall plant quality performance. 2. Establish and continuously improve quality control processes for commercial vehicle assembly, including incoming inspection, station inspection, in-process inspection, quality gates, end-of-line testing, road testing, PDI, and final vehicle release. 3. Establish critical quality control points throughout the vehicle manufacturing process, with particular focus on the chassis, axles, powertrain, cab, electrical harnesses, braking system, steering system, lighting, sealing, critical torque, and overall vehicle functionality. 4. Establish vehicle release and stop-release mechanisms. Promptly quarantine, rework, stop shipment, and escalate any vehicle that fails to meet applicable quality, safety, or regulatory requirements. 5. Lead the resolution of major on-site quality issues. Organize containment actions, defect reproduction, 8D analysis, 5 Whys, and root-cause validation, and implement permanent corrective actions with lessons learned deployed across similar products and processes. 6. Establish a rapid-response mechanism for batch quality issues. Organize quality walls, 100% inspections, sorting, rework, and screening of potentially affected vehicles to prevent defective vehicles and components from reaching the market. 7. Lead quality planning for new models and new projects, including risk identification during the APQP phase, DFMEA and PFMEA reviews, Control Plan development, inspection standard development, and quality gate planning. 8. Manage quality follow-up during prototype builds, trial builds, pilot production, and production ramp-up. Drive closure of open issues, confirm process capability, and approve quality readiness for serial production. 9. Participate in product and process change management to ensure alignment among the Bill of Materials, drawings, process documents, software versions, inspection standards, and actual production configuration, preventing incorrect assembly, missing parts, and mixed product versions. 10. Establish control and traceability mechanisms for special characteristics, critical dimensions, critical torque values, and regulatory components, ensuring that all relevant quality data is accurate, complete, and readily traceable. 11. Manage the calibration and control of gauges, measuring instruments, inspection equipment, and testing equipment. Organize Measurement System Analysis, Statistical Process Control, and process capability studies. 12. Collaborate with the Supplier Quality team to resolve incoming material defects and supplier-related batch quality issues. Drive suppliers to implement containment actions, complete 8D corrective actions, and achieve sustained improvement. 13. Establish a closed-loop process for after-sales quality issues. Regularly analyze failures reported by dealers, service centers, fleet customers, and end users, and drive improvements in product design, manufacturing processes, assembly, and inspection. 14. Analyze warranty claims, early-life failures, repeat repairs, and major customer complaints to reduce market PPM, failures per 1,000 vehicles, warranty claim rates, and warranty cost per vehicle. 15. Promptly organize risk assessments for issues involving vehicle safety, regulatory compliance, or potential batch exposure. Support field containment, recall assessments, vehicle rectification campaigns, and communication with regulatory authorities. 16. Establish and maintain the IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. Organize internal audits, process audits, product audits, management reviews, third-party certification audits, and customer audits. 17. Ensure that audit nonconformities, customer complaints, and internal quality issues are analyzed, corrected, verified, and formally closed within the required timelines, preventing recurrence of similar issues. 18. Collaborate with Product Compliance, Homologation, Certification, and Engineering teams to ensure that vehicle conformity of production, product configuration, and quality release comply with applicable Brazilian vehicle approval, environmental, and safety requirements. 19. Establish a plant quality KPI management system, conduct regular quality review meetings, and issue daily, weekly, monthly, and special quality improvement reports. 20. Manage quality-related costs, including rework, scrap, customer claims, and warranty expenses. Identify major sources of quality loss and lead cost-reduction initiatives. 21. Take responsibility for the organizational planning of the quality team, including recruitment, staffing, role definition, skills matrices, training and certification, performance coaching, and succession planning. 22. Establish departmental and individual KPIs, cascade annual objectives, conduct regular performance reviews, and ensure that the team achieves the quality targets required by the company. 23. Collaborate with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, R&D, Purchasing, Supplier Quality, After-Sales Service, Product Compliance, Homologation, and Sales teams to ensure the timely resolution of quality issues. 24. Establish an emergency-response mechanism for major quality risks. In the event of batch failures, major customer complaints, or safety-related quality incidents, organize an immediate response and promptly report the situation to senior management.

title: 经理
description:
Empresa está contratando 经理 em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

1. Assume overall responsibility for the industrial complex’s HSE team and management system. Develop annual HSE objectives, work plans, workforce plans, departmental budgets, and key improvement projects, and be accountable for overall HSE performance. 2. Establish and continuously improve HSE policies, standards, procedures, inspection mechanisms, and accountability systems in accordance with applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, and corporate requirements. 3. Establish an occupational risk management system and organize the implementation of Occupational Risk Management and the Risk Management Program (GRO/PGR), including risk identification and assessment, preparation of the occupational risk inventory and action plans, and ongoing monitoring of the effectiveness of risk control measures. 4. Organize routine safety inspections, special inspections, and management safety tours covering manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, utilities, equipment maintenance, laboratories, and office areas. 5. Establish a permit-to-work system for high-risk activities, with particular focus on hot work, work at height, confined-space entry, temporary electrical installations, electrical work, lifting operations, excavation, equipment maintenance, energy isolation, and work on pressurized systems. 6. Establish and supervise a Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) energy isolation program to prevent unexpected startup, electrical energization, pressurization, or energy release during equipment maintenance, commissioning, and cleaning. 7. Manage safety risks associated with machinery and equipment, electrical systems, regulated equipment, pressure vessels, lifting equipment, forklifts, storage racks, industrial gases, and utility facilities. 8. Ensure compliance with the Brazilian Regulatory Standards (Normas Regulamentadoras – NRs) applicable to the site’s risk profile, including requirements relating to machinery, electricity, material handling, ergonomics, flammable materials, fire protection, confined spaces, and work at height. 9. Lead the establishment and effective operation of the Specialized Services in Safety Engineering and Occupational Medicine (SESMT), coordinating occupational safety engineers, safety technicians, occupational physicians, occupational health nurses, and other professionals in the lawful performance of their duties. 10. Support the lawful establishment and effective operation of the Internal Commission for Accident and Harassment Prevention (CIPA), encouraging employee participation in hazard identification, accident prevention, safety improvement, and workplace harassment prevention. 11. Work with the occupational health and Human Resources teams to establish and implement the Occupational Health Medical Control Program (PCMSO), including occupational medical examinations, occupational exposure monitoring, occupational disease prevention, return-to-work management, and employee health promotion. 12. Ensure that occupational health and safety documentation and eSocial SST information are submitted in a timely, accurate, and complete manner, including information relating to workplace accidents, employee health surveillance, and occupational hazard exposure. 13. Organize the identification, assessment, monitoring, and control of occupational hazards, including noise, heat, dust, chemicals, vibration, radiation, lighting, and ergonomic risks. 14. Incorporate ergonomics and work-related psychosocial risks into occupational risk assessments and improvement plans, and continuously improve work organization, workstation design, and employee health management. 15. Establish a contractor HSE qualification and lifecycle management system covering contractor qualification reviews, site induction, risk communication, work permits, on-site supervision, performance evaluation, and disciplinary action for violations. 16. Implement lifecycle HSE management for site construction, expansion and modification projects, equipment installation, and commissioning. Participate in design reviews, construction method statement reviews, pre-startup readiness confirmation, and final safety acceptance. 17. Integrate HSE requirements into reviews of new projects, equipment, processes, materials, and engineering changes to ensure that safety and environmental risks are identified and controlled before implementation or commissioning. 18. Manage the procurement approval, storage, use, transportation, labeling, Safety Data Sheets, and emergency response requirements for chemicals, flammable and explosive materials, dangerous goods, and industrial gases. 19. Establish appropriate controls for electric shock, thermal runaway, fire, and chemical leakage risks associated with power batteries, high-voltage systems, electric drive systems, charging facilities, and battery energy storage systems. 20. Establish a fire safety management system covering the installation and maintenance of fire protection systems, fire access routes and evacuation passages, fire risk inspections, emergency evacuation, fire brigade management, and fire safety permits and licenses. 21. Establish a comprehensive emergency management system for the industrial complex and develop emergency response plans for fires, explosions, chemical spills, electric shock, confined-space incidents, falls from height, environmental pollution, extreme weather, and other foreseeable emergencies. 22. Organize emergency response teams, emergency resources and equipment, incident command mechanisms, and regular emergency drills. Evaluate drill performance and implement continuous improvements. 23. Establish reporting mechanisms for incidents, near misses, and high-potential events. Organize scene preservation, evidence collection, investigations, root cause analysis, corrective action verification, and site-wide sharing and implementation of lessons learned. 24. Organize rapid response to major injuries or fatalities, fires and explosions, environmental pollution, and other high-risk events. Promptly report such events to company management and support statutory external reporting and regulatory investigations. 25. Lead the establishment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System and ISO 14001 Environmental Management System. 26. Organize HSE internal audits, compliance evaluations, management reviews, customer audits, and third-party certification audits, and ensure that all nonconformities are corrected and verified within the required timeframe. 27. Establish and maintain a register of applicable HSE laws, regulations, permits, and licenses. Regularly identify regulatory changes, assess compliance gaps, and drive corrective actions. 28. Lead or coordinate applications, amendments, renewals, and condition management for environmental licenses and related approvals, ensuring that all licenses and their associated conditions remain valid and are fully implemented. 29. Maintain the necessary professional communication with IBAMA, relevant state environmental agencies, local government authorities, labor inspection bodies, fire departments, and other regulatory agencies, and coordinate regulatory inspections and document submissions. 30. Establish environmental management and monitoring mechanisms covering wastewater, air emissions, noise, solid waste, hazardous waste, soil, groundwater, and water abstraction and use. 31. Manage the classification, labeling, storage, transfer, transportation, and compliant disposal of hazardous and general industrial waste, ensuring that Waste Transport Manifests (MTRs) and final disposal certificates are complete and fully traceable. 32. Manage environmental monitoring programs and regularly analyze data relating to air emissions, wastewater discharge, noise, water consumption, energy consumption, waste generation, recycling, and resource recovery. 33. Establish environmental pollution prevention and spill-control mechanisms, with particular focus on chemical storage areas, oils and fuels, wastewater treatment facilities, hazardous waste temporary storage areas, and stormwater and wastewater drainage systems. 34. Manage the investigation, corrective action, reporting, and closure of environmental complaints, spills, abnormal discharges, and other environmental incidents. 35. Establish an HSE training system and organize induction training, specialized training, and competency certification for new employees, transferred employees, contractors, and personnel engaged in high-risk activities. 36. Promote a strong site-wide safety culture by establishing hazard reporting, near-miss reporting, stop-work authority, management safety observations, and employee participation and improvement mechanisms. 37. Establish an HSE KPI management system, organize regular HSE meetings, and issue daily, weekly, monthly, and special risk reports. 38. Manage HSE expenditures relating to personal protective equipment, fire protection systems, occupational health surveillance, environmental monitoring, waste disposal, and external professional services, while continuously identifying improvement and cost-optimization opportunities. 39. Manage HSE organizational planning, recruitment and staffing, job responsibilities, competency matrices, professional training, performance coaching, succession planning, and talent development. 40. Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Equipment, Logistics, Quality, Human Resources, Procurement, Legal, Government Affairs, Facilities Management, and other departments to ensure the timely resolution of HSE issues.

title: Customer Service Representative - English & Spanish
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Customer Service Representative - English & Spanish em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Xenon arc   At Xenon arc, we’re transforming how producers connect with their customers.  We partner with leading companies—ranging from industrial chemical manufacturers to global food ingredient providers—to solve complex challenges in reaching and serving hard-to-access markets. By acting as an extension of our clients' brands, we help them grow sales, optimize operations, and embrace digital transformation.  Our teams bring technical expertise, innovative digital tools, and a customer-focused approach to drive exceptional results. We don’t just distribute products—we create solutions that strengthen client-customer relationships and build lasting success.  Reports to   Commercial Manager  Summary   To accomplish our goals and serve our clients better, we are looking for individuals eager to develop our next customer sales campaigns, drive revenue and convert new business opportunities. You will work directly with our clients’ most interesting and demanding customers; helping us better understand their needs, develop product forecast models and deliver a strong overall customer experience.  Essential Job Duties   In this role, you will act as the interface between customers and the business value chain partners to deliver exceptional service to our customers and drive profitability  You will provide solutions to the customer while managing operational needs and collaborating closely with operational partners to meet company objectives  Executes the order entry process and manages the order fulfillment process for a given business or group of businesses and customers, which are typically priority and foundational customers with a high degree of complexity  Maintains a thorough knowledge of the businesses' products, businesses, applications, and service offerings  Coordinates activity at assigned customer accounts, proactively address issues and implement solutions  Maintains service levels according to business prioritization  Strengthens customer intimacy by developing solid relationships, understanding customer needs and gathering market intelligence  Attracts potential customers by answering product and service questions and suggesting information about other products and services.  Maintains customer records by updating account information.  Escalating queries and concerns.  Ensuring that customers are satisfied with products or services.  Recommends potential products or services to management by collecting customer information and analyzing customer needs.  Prepares product or service reports by collecting and analyzing customer information.  Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.   Basic Qualifications   Proficient in English, Spanish proficiency a plus Completed Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in a customer service role  Proficiency in MS Office Suite  Strong team player; motivated and extremely customer centric  Analytical and problem-solving ability  Strong verbal and written communication skills  Experience in customer management   Preferred Qualifications   Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in science or chemistry-related industry  Previous experience in Customer Service or B2B Customer Support  Demonstrated ability to work effectively across internal and external organizations  Experienced in use of customer relationship management (CRM) software   Preferred Level of Experience   5+ years of work experience in customer service or similar roles  Location & Commitments   Full time  Hybrid – report to Campinas, BR office   Physical Demands   Must be able to remain in a stationary position  Must be able to operate a computer   Travel Required   Minimal (up to 10%)  Affirmative Action/EEO Statement   It is the policy of Xenon arc to grant equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, national origin, ethnicity, marital status, parental status, disability, veteran status, age, religion, political affiliation, gender, sex, gender identity, or sexual orientation. It is the intent and desire of Xenon arc that equal employment opportunity will be provided in all phases of the employment relationship.  Other Duties   Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Atender dúvidas dos participantes, apoiar a solução de questões relacionadas às plataformas de ações e gerenciar chamados junto aos administradores dos planos. Vivência em ambientes multiculturais e equipes distribuídas globalmente.   Atuação com conciliações, processamento de dados ou folha de pagamento.   Experiência em empresas multinacionais.   Participação em projetos de transição, centralização ou transformação de processos. Conhecimento básico em remuneração baseada em ações, tributação e impactos em folha de pagamento será considerado um diferencial.   Familiaridade com  Workday, EquatePlus, sistemas de folha de pagamento, ferramentas de automação ou reporting   será um diferencial. title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.    Core Responsibilities:    Student Support & Intervention    Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.   Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.   Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.   Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.   Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.   Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.   Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.   Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.   Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.   Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.   Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.   Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.   Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.   Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.   Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.   Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.   Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.   Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.   Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.   Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.   Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).   Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.     Collaboration    Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.   Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.   Monitor students’ progress and well-being.   Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.   Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.   Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.   Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.   Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.   Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.   Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.     Operational and Professional Conduct    Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.   Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.   Maintain accurate student records.   Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.   Participate in professional development opportunities.   Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.   Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.   Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide  .     Other duties, as assigned.    Working Conditions:    Walk on paths and rough terrain   May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up     POSITION REQUIREMENTS    Minimum Education Required:     BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent   Minimum Experience Required:    Five years of teaching experience, preferred   Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.   Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.    Specific Knowledge:    Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.   Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.   Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.    Other Skills (Desirable):    Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.   Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.   Collegial and collaborative.   Innovative and creative.   Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.    English level required:    C1 or above   Portuguese level required:    none for teachers instructing in English   C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese    Child Safeguarding    Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.    EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion    EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Coordenador(a) Tributário
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Coordenador(a) Tributário em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

QUEM SOMOS    Nascemos fruto da união de propósitos entre a Bunge e UPL, uma joint venture de proposta inovadora e exclusiva: levar a solução completa ao produtor.   Somos a ORÍGEO e viemos construir uma relação próxima que simplifique o dia a dia da lavoura, lado a lado do produtor sendo seu parceiro da semente à comercialização, visando uma agricultura produtiva, sustentável e em constante evolução.    OBJETIVO DA POSIÇÃO     Garantir a governança fiscal e tributária da organização, com foco principal em tributos indiretos, especialmente ICMS nos diversos estados do Brasil, PIS e COFINS, assegurando que as atividades executadas pelo SSC e demais áreas envolvidas estejam em conformidade com a legislação vigente, políticas internas e diretrizes da ORÍGEO. O Coordenador Tributário atua como referência técnica e ponto focal entre Controladoria, SSC, áreas de negócio, consultorias, auditorias e órgãos fiscalizadores, acompanhando a qualidade das entregas, validando criticamente apurações, obrigações acessórias, créditos fiscais, controles e tratativas fiscais relevantes. Este papel é estratégico para a mitigação de riscos fiscais, otimização tributária dentro dos limites legais, suporte à tomada de decisão e condução dos impactos decorrentes da Reforma Tributária, com foco em processos, sistemas, créditos fiscais, fluxo financeiro, contabilização, controles internos e aderência operacional ao novo modelo tributário.    ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES     Governança da Conformidade Fiscal e Acompanhamento do SSC:   acompanhar e validar criticamente as apurações, recolhimentos, créditos, obrigações acessórias e demais rotinas fiscais executadas pelo SSC, com foco principal em tributos indiretos, especialmente ICMS nos diversos estados do Brasil, PIS e COFINS, assegurando aderência à legislação federal, estadual e municipal, às políticas internas, prazos, controles e padrões de qualidade definidos pela ORÍGEO.   Gestão Técnica da Equipe Tributária:   coordenar, orientar e desenvolver os Analistas Tributários Sênior e Pleno, distribuindo prioridades, revisando entregas críticas, promovendo capacitação técnica e garantindo alinhamento das atividades com as demandas da Controladoria e do negócio.   Gestão de Riscos Fiscais, Controles e Auditorias:   identificar, avaliar e mitigar riscos fiscais decorrentes das operações, acompanhar fiscalizações, auditorias internas e externas, intimações e demandas de órgãos fazendários, garantindo consistência das informações preparadas pelo SSC, equipe interna ou áreas responsáveis.   Planejamento e Eficiência Tributária:   avaliar oportunidades de planejamento tributário, benefícios fiscais estaduais, regimes especiais, créditos de ICMS, créditos de PIS e COFINS, créditos de tributos indiretos e alternativas legais que contribuam para eficiência fiscal, proteção da margem e suporte às decisões financeiras, comerciais e operacionais da companhia.   Reforma Tributária e Transformação Fiscal:   monitorar a evolução legislativa e regulatória da Reforma Tributária, avaliando impactos prioritariamente sobre tributos indiretos, incluindo ICMS nos diversos estados do Brasil, PIS e COFINS, créditos fiscais, processos, sistemas, cadastros, parametrizações fiscais, formação de preços, fluxo de caixa, contabilização e controles internos, coordenando planos de ação com SSC, TI, Contabilidade, Comercial, Suprimentos e Operações.   Interface com Áreas de Negócio e Consultoria Técnica:   atuar como ponto focal tributário para Controladoria, Contabilidade, Comercial, Suprimentos, Operações, Jurídico, TI e SSC, traduzindo temas fiscais complexos em orientações práticas, riscos, impactos financeiros e recomendações para tomada de decisão.   Contabilidade Tributária e Fechamento:   acompanhar conciliações fiscais e contábeis, provisões, créditos de ICMS, créditos de PIS e COFINS, créditos de tributos indiretos, saldos tributários, impactos no fechamento mensal e documentação de suporte, assegurando consistência entre registros contábeis, informações fiscais e controles internos.   Sistemas, Cadastros e Parametrizações Fiscais:   acompanhar e validar regras fiscais em sistemas, cadastros de produtos, clientes e fornecedores, NCM, CFOP, CST, alíquotas, retenções, naturezas fiscais, regras de ICMS por unidade federativa e demais parametrizações relevantes, propondo melhorias para reduzir riscos, retrabalho e inconsistências operacionais.   Indicadores, SLAs e Melhoria Contínua:   monitorar indicadores de qualidade, prazo, retrabalho, pendências e exceções nas entregas do SSC e da equipe tributária, promovendo fóruns de alinhamento, planos de ação, automação de controles e melhoria contínua dos processos fiscais.   Preços de Transferência e Temas Especiais:   coordenar tecnicamente temas tributários específicos, incluindo Preços de Transferência, regimes especiais, benefícios fiscais e demandas estratégicas, interagindo com consultorias, auditorias e áreas internas para garantir conformidade e adequada documentação de suporte.     QUALIFICAÇÕES     Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.   Experiência sólida na área tributária, com atuação predominante em tributos indiretos, especialmente ICMS nos diversos estados do Brasil, PIS e COFINS, compliance fiscal, planejamento tributário, auditorias, fechamento contábil/fiscal e gestão de riscos.   Experiência prévia com SSC, BPO, consultorias, auditorias e áreas de negócio.   Conhecimento sólido em legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipal, com ênfase em tributos indiretos, especialmente ICMS nos diversos estados do Brasil, PIS e COFINS, créditos fiscais, retenções, obrigações acessórias, benefícios fiscais estaduais e regimes especiais.   Conhecimento em SPED, EFD-Contribuições, ECD, ECF, DCTFWeb, EFD-Reinf, PER/DCOMP e demais obrigações fiscais aplicáveis.   Vivência em ERP (preferencialmente SAP ou similares), parametrizações fiscais, cadastros tributários, conciliações fiscais e contábeis, controles internos e fechamento mensal.   Conhecimento atualizado sobre Reforma Tributária, com capacidade de avaliar impactos sobre ICMS, PIS e COFINS, tributos indiretos, processos, sistemas, créditos, fluxo de caixa, precificação, contabilização e obrigações acessórias.   Excel avançado e domínio de ferramentas analíticas.   Disponibilidade para viagens.     Desejável:   Pós-graduação, MBA ou especialização em Direito Tributário, Gestão Tributária, Controladoria, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.   Experiência com Power BI, automação de controles e análise de dados fiscais.   Experiência prévia no Agronegócio.     Nós, da ORÍGEO, acreditamos que um time com diversidade constrói grandes histórias. Por isso, se você é uma Pessoa com Deficiência e se identificou com essa vaga, participe do nosso processo seletivo!

title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
Empresa está contratando Regional Sales Representative em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Position Details   Job Title:   Regional Sales Representative — Campinas, São Paulo   Department:   Sales — IoT/M2M Connectivity   Location:   Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil — field-based and remote work, with frequent regional travel   Employment Type:   Full-Time (CLT or PJ, to be defined based on candidate profile)  Reports To:   Head of Sales LATAM    Role Context    We are expanding our commercial team in Brazil with dedicated territorial coverage by region. São Paulo, anchored in Campinas, is part of this expansion, given the volume of strategic accounts already established in the area and the active presence of competitors (Virtueyes, Datatem, Allcom, among others).    What You'll Do    Prospect, develop, and close deals with medium and large companies in São Paulo, focused on fleet management, asset tracking, and related IoT verticals.   Act as the local commercial point of contact, with recurring in-person presence at clients and prospects across São Paulo.   Build and manage your own pipeline, from qualification through close, in coordination with the Head of Sales LATAM and the Inside Sales/SDR team.   Track and monitor local competitors (MVNOs and IoT connectivity providers operating in the region).   Present technical-commercial proposals, including products such as SIM DUO, vSIM, and eSIM, together with the Solutions team.   Negotiate contracts, commercial terms, and SLAs with corporate clients.   Report pipeline metrics, forecast, and results in a structured way.     What We Expect    Farm and Grow the Existing Base    Take ownership of and grow the accounts already established in São Paulo, increasing volume and revenue within the current portfolio.   Keep clients satisfied through constant visits and recurring in-person presence — not just remote contact.   Ensure fast response to client requests and demands, acting as their trusted local point of contact.   Anticipate churn risk and act proactively to retain and expand strategic accounts.    Grow — Bring In New Accounts    Prospect and close new accounts quickly, with a strong sense of urgency and focus on results.   Directly contribute to revenue growth in the region, not just maintenance of the current portfolio.   Establish Acceleronix's active presence in São Paulo — participation in events, trade shows, and visits that reinforce the brand locally.   Build a consistent pipeline of new business, without relying solely on leads handed over by the SDR team.     Requirements    Required    Based in Campinas, São Paulo, or willing to relocate to the region.   Proven track record in consultative B2B sales, preferably in telecom, connectivity, IoT/M2M, or technology.   Hybrid farmer/hunter profile — able to grow existing accounts while also generating and converting new pipeline.   Availability for frequent travel within the region.   Strong written and verbal communication, autonomy, and organization to manage a complex sales cycle.    Nice to Have    Prior experience at an MVNO, carrier, or IoT/M2M connectivity provider.   Familiarity with industry concepts: SIM DUO, vSIM, eSIM, national roaming, ICCID/IMSI/IMEI, LTE-M, NB-IoT.   Existing relationships with clients or partners in fleet management and vehicle tracking in São Paulo.   Intermediate/advanced English, for interaction with the Quectel group.     About Acceleronix    Acceleronix is Quectel's integrated IoT platform and connectivity company, built to help businesses launch and scale connected products faster. The company provides consulting, PCBA design, global SIM connectivity, and a secure device management platform, bringing hardware, connectivity, and software together into a single, end-to-end offering rather than requiring customers to stitch together separate vendors.    Operating as part of the Quectel ecosystem, Acceleronix is positioned as a trusted end-to-end IoT partner delivering scalable, reliable solutions from design through deployment, and appears alongside Quectel at major industry events such as MWC and the World IT Show to showcase joint IoT deployments across smart agriculture, smart home, and connected-device use cases.    Compensation & Benefits    Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market   Sales commission / performance bonus tied to new business and account growth   Meal and grocery vouchers   Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents   Dental coverage   Life insurance and accident cover   Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law   Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization     Learn More    Explore products, careers, and news at  , or follow  Quectel Wireless Solutions  on LinkedIn.   Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.     Acceleronix is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Somos líderes em certificação de produtos no Brasil, atuando com ANATEL, INMETRO e inovação contínua. Nossa missão é acelerar o crescimento dos nossos clientes com processos ágeis, confiáveis e orientados por dados.    Missão do cargo:    Responsável por garantir uma experiência fluida e transparente para o cliente após a venda, atuando como o elo central de comunicação entre cliente, áreas internas da empresa (Engenharia, Comercial, Logística, Financeiro) e laboratórios parceiros.
